import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        boolean at = false;
        
        int len = s.length();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 2).equals("at") && !at && i != 0 && i != len - 2) {
                ret.append('@');
                at = true;
                i++;
            } else if (i + 3 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot") && i != 0 && i != len - 3) {
                ret.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                ret.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        
        System.out.print(ret.toString());
    }
}
